name: V ritme nashikh serdets
source:
The protagonist Semyon, who loves music in his own world, notices upon arriving at the camp that there is a music club. Musical and guitar passions do not subside even in Sovyonok. And now, together with a beautiful girl with aquamarine hair.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889784391]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人公谢苗在自己的世界里热爱音乐，一到营地就注意到有一个音乐俱乐部。即使在索维诺克，人们对音乐和吉他的热情也没有消退。而现在，身边还有一位有着碧绿色头发的美丽少女。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2889784391]Steam[/url]]
